thread:
Noah Kim: opened a migration guide PR for HSM failover handling in private deployments. needs examples for Calico egress policy, iptables fallback, and a short Java SDK snippet for sidecar usage. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4680

Zara Ahmed: thanks. one major ask from support: document the sequence for cutover when promoting a DR HSM gateway (IP swap + cert rotate). a tiny checklist would help SREs.

Noah Kim: good idea. adding a checklist: 1) ensure new HSM gateway reachable from private-nodes via egress rules; 2) rotate cert on sidecar; 3) update REDWOOD_KMS_ENDPOINT and restart sidecar; 4) monitor TLS handshakes for failures.

Tom Ruiz: for Calico, customers usually need a HostEndpoint or a GlobalNetworkPolicy that allows the specific gateway IP on 4731. prefer a small example that uses labels instead of IPs where possible.

Noah Kim: adding this Calico example to PR:```yaml
apiVersion: projectcalico.org/v3
kind: GlobalNetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-hsm-failover-egress
spec:
  selector: role == 'private-node'
  egress:
  - action: Allow
    protocol: TCP
    destination:
      nets: ['10.4.0.0/24']
      ports: [4731]
  order: 150
```

Zara Ahmed: include note: if using HostEndpoints, remember to update the endpoint spec to point to the new physical host when doing IP move. adds a small HostEndpoint snippet too.

Noah Kim: done. also adding an iptables fallback example for older customers:```bash
# allow HSM traffic to new gateway 10.4.0.5:4731
iptables -I OUTPUT 1 -p tcp -d 10.4.0.5 --dport 4731 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
iptables -I INPUT 1 -p tcp -s 10.4.0.5 --sport 4731 -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
```

Tom Ruiz: add a short note about conntrack table exhaustion during mass failovers; include how to increase nf_conntrack_max and why to stagger restarts.

Noah Kim: added conntrack note and a staggered restart example in the checklist: restart sidecars in waves of 50 nodes.

Zara Ahmed: for the Java SDK snippet, show how to set base URL to local sidecar and how to set the KMS endpoint env var. keep it minimal.

Noah Kim: Java example added:```java
import com.redwood.Client;
public class Example {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    Client client = new Client.Builder()
      .apiKey("REDACTED")
      .baseUrl("http://127.0.0.1:8080")
      .build();
    System.out.println(client.generate("hi").getText());
  }
}
```

Tom Ruiz: also a small troubleshooting tip: on air-gapped installs, TLS name validation against rotated certs can fail if sidecar does SNI rewrite; document enabling hostname override carefully.

Noah Kim: added troubleshooting paragraph: common symptom = "certificate subject mismatch"; quick fix = set sidecar config to preserve original CN during validation or update sidecar TLS config after rotate. WARN box: never disable TLS verification in production.
